[P1] Handle exhaustion when the last waiting candidate becomes skipped

Consider `DurableFuture.anyOf(b)` called before another branch wins a `firstSuccessful()` parallel. When `b` becomes skipped, this iteration removes it because `eligible` was nonempty. The next iteration passes an empty list to `awaitFirstSettledOperation()`, whose `CompletableFuture.anyOf()` never completes. The caller can hang or trigger invalid suspension instead of receiving `ParallelBranchSkippedException`; replay with an already-skipped branch behaves differently. Retain a skipped fallback and return it when candidates are exhausted. Test a branch that becomes skipped after the wait begins.
